evals.prompt: We've got a pile of session retros in .claude/PRPs/reports/ and I'm pretty sure half the proposals in them never got actioned. Can you go through them and tell me what's actually still open vs already done? I don't want to re-read 50 files myself.
evals.expected_output: A ranked harvest report at .claude/PRPs/reports/retro-harvest-<date>.md that extracts unprocessed proposals, triages each STALE/LIVE/SUPERSEDED with citable evidence checked against HEAD, groups into 3 tiers, plus an Unverified-STALE section and ordered action sequence. No rules/lessons/code edited; no source-retro checkbox ticked.
assertions: Harvest report written at .claude/PRPs/reports/retro-harvest-<date>.md
Report contains Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 sections
Scope line states session-retro + phase-retro counts and date window
Tier-1/2 rows carry negative-evidence (still-LIVE proof)
Tier-3 rows carry positive-evidence (STALE/SUPERSEDED proof)
Has an 'Unverified STALE claims' section
Has an ordered 'Suggested action sequence'
No tracked rule/lesson/code/script modified
No source-retro checkbox ticked

evals.prompt: harvest the retro backlog from the last week — just the recent ones, not the whole history. I want to know the top 2-3 things worth doing now.
evals.expected_output: Harvest report scoped to ~7 days with Tier-1 surfacing 2-3 highest-leverage LIVE proposals, each with recurrence + negative-evidence. Scope line states the effective window. Read-only.
assertions: Harvest report written at canonical path
Scope line states ~7-day window, not the 21-day default
Tier 1 surfaces ~2-3 items (answers 'top 2-3')
Each Tier-1 item has recurrence + negative-evidence
Highest-leverage single item called out explicitly
No tracked file modified; no checkbox ticked

evals.prompt: Before I start the next phase I want to make sure we're not about to re-walk into something a past retro already flagged. Check the retro proposals for anything unimplemented that's high-recurrence — stuff that came up in more than one retro.
evals.expected_output: Harvest report emphasising recurrence >=2 LIVE proposals with evidence each is still unimplemented at HEAD, an explicit already-implemented set, and unverified-STALE downgraded to LIVE. Does not auto-implement anything.
assertions: Harvest report written at canonical path
Recurrence computed as count of distinct retro files, >=2 threshold applied
Tier 1 emphasises high-recurrence LIVE proposals
Each high-recurrence LIVE item has negative-evidence
Explicit 'already implemented, do NOT re-propose' STALE set
Unverified STALE downgraded to LIVE and listed separately
No tracked file modified; no checkbox ticked; no Tier-1 auto-implemented
